_comment: Executable contract for gateway service notices (user-role transcript rows that are the agent's side: delegation results, background-process reports, the gateway's consolidated batches) and for Cuate's continuation turn. Every `text` was rendered by the real formatters of Hermes 0.21.5 (v2026.9.24): tools/process_registry_notifications.py, and the consolidation header of gateway/run_notifications.py. Consumed by BOTH platforms' tests (Swift: scripts/ServiceNoticeContractTest.swift via scripts/test-attach-note.sh; Kotlin: android unit test HermesServiceNoticeTest). Any change to HermesServiceNotice / HermesContinuationFrame on either side must keep every case green on both.
